correctness.rationale: The all-positive and all-negative traces force the two edge counts. For any prescribed independent positive trace, take an edge in the nonquery complement: either endpoint with a trace neighbor has exactly one such neighbor (degree at most two), so add only that endpoint; otherwise add both endpoints. A positive trace already inducing an edge needs no completion. This also handles edgeless and empty graphs, and the diamond gives a valid failure above degree two. On paths the conditions are at most one 11 and at least one 00. Independently summing over runs of ones gives A=(1+tz)/(1-t-t²z)+(tz)²/(1-t-t²z)² and B=(1+t)(1+tz)/(1-t²z)+(1+t)²(tz)²/(1-t²z)², exactly the submitted rational series after combining terms. Counting adjacent pair types gives the stated upper VC bound; 1100 followed by alternating 10 pairs, with a final 1 for odd length, attains it from n=4 onwards. The small path cases and the stable coefficient formula follow from the available zero gaps. Independent gap-binomial counts and bit-word enumeration agree through n=12.
